intuition: The smallest remaining node must be one of the two list heads.

brute_force.approach: Collect all values, sort them, and build a new linked list.

optimal.approach: Use a sentinel and repeatedly attach the smaller current node, then append whichever list remains.

edge_cases: Either input list may be empty.
Equal values can be taken from either list without changing sorted order.
Append the untouched remainder once one list is exhausted.
